title: Qualify immutable Foundation local NuGet publisher on a disposable feed with five source-free binary checks
commitMessage: test: qualify Foundation immutable NuGet publisher rehearsal

contribution.summary: Rehearse the immutable Foundation NuGet publisher using seven actual commands, five independent binary identity checks and collision/digest/cancellation refusals in a disposable feed only.
contribution.value: Reuse pinned Dw.Tools.NuGet to build the exact one-source Foundation project in a temporary packing projection, publish/read back its new rehearsal archive, and prove zero dependencies without mutating NUGET_LOCAL.

Actual private feed publication, replacement and installed rollback are excluded; owner must explicitly invoke guarded modes after separate successful DWF delivery.
